reports.title: Guide
reports.query:
**This report is for browsing Activity Concepts**

It displays the Activity Concepts (**latest** version) available in the StudyBuilder Library.

Follow the tabs to see different views of the concepts.

For more information on activity concepts you can read this 
**[article on Biomedical Concepts/Activity Concepts](https://novo-nordisk.gitlab.io/nn-public/openstudybuilder/project-description/guide_activity_concept)**

reports.title: Number of Activities and Instances by Group and Subgroup
reports.query:
MATCH(act:ActivityValue)-[R1:HAS_GROUPING]->(g:ActivityGrouping)-[R2:HAS_SELECTED_SUBGROUP]->(asgrp:ActivitySubGroupValue),
(g)-[R4:HAS_SELECTED_GROUP]->(agrp:ActivityGroupValue),(act)<-[:LATEST]-()
MATCH(g:ActivityGrouping)<-[R5:HAS_ACTIVITY]-(aigv:ActivityInstanceGroupingValue)<-[:LATEST]-(aigr:ActivityInstanceGroupingRoot)<-[:HAS_GROUPING_ROOT]-(air:ActivityInstanceRoot)-[:LATEST]->(ai:ActivityInstanceValue)
return distinct agrp.name as `Activity Group`, 
asgrp.name as `Activity Subgroup`,
count(distinct act.name) as `Number of Activities`,
count(distinct ai.name) as `Number of Activity Instances`

reports.title: Groupings of Activities

(g)-[R4:HAS_SELECTED_GROUP]->(agrp:ActivityGroupValue),(act)<-[:LATEST]-()

reports.title: Activity as a Graph View (Logical View) - $neodash_activity
reports.query:
//Logical view of Activity and intances
MATCH
  (act:ActivityValue)-[R1:HAS_GROUPING]->
  (g:ActivityGrouping)-[R2:HAS_SELECTED_SUBGROUP]->
  (asgrp:ActivitySubGroupValue),
  (g)-[R4:HAS_SELECTED_GROUP]->(agrp:ActivityGroupValue)<-[:LATEST]-()
WHERE act.name = $neodash_activity
MATCH (g:ActivityGrouping)<-[R5:HAS_ACTIVITY]-(aigv:ActivityInstanceGroupingValue)<-[:LATEST]-(aigr:ActivityInstanceGroupingRoot)<-[:HAS_GROUPING_ROOT]-(air:ActivityInstanceRoot)-[:LATEST]->(ai:ActivityInstanceValue)
MATCH
  (ai)-[R7:ACTIVITY_INSTANCE_CLASS]->
  (aicr:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)-[R8:LATEST]->
  (aic:ActivityInstanceClassValue)
WITH DISTINCT
  g,
  agrp,
  asgrp,
  act,
  ai,
  aicr,
  apoc.create.vNode(["ActivityInstance"], properties(ai)) AS v_ai,
  apoc.create.vNode(["ActivityInstanceClass"], properties(aic)) AS v_aic,
  R1,
  R2,
  R4,
  R5
WITH DISTINCT
  g,
  agrp,
  asgrp,
  act,
  ai,
  aicr,
  v_ai,
  v_aic,
  apoc.create.vRelationship(act, "HAS", {type: "logical"}, v_ai) AS r1,
  apoc.create.vRelationship(v_ai, "HAS_ACTIVITY", {type: "logical"}, g) AS r2,
  apoc.create.vRelationship(v_ai, "OF_CLASS", {type: "logical"}, v_aic) AS r3,
  R1,
  R2,
  R4,
  R5
WITH DISTINCT
  g,
  agrp,
  asgrp,
  act,
  ai,
  aicr,
  v_ai,
  v_aic,
  r1,
  r2,
  r3,
  R1,
  R2,
  R4,
  R5
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aicr)-[R11:PARENT_CLASS]->
  (aicrp:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)-[R12:LATEST]->
  (aicp:ActivityInstanceClassValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aicrp)-[R13:PARENT_CLASS]->
  (aicrpp:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)-[R14:LATEST]->
  (aicpp:ActivityInstanceClassValue)
//Items
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (ai:ActivityInstanceValue)-[R6:CONTAINS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]->
  (aitm1)<-[R9:HAS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]-
  (aitmc1r:ActivityItemClassRoot)-[R10:LATEST]->
  (aitmc1:ActivityItemClassValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitmc1r)<-[R15:HAS_ITEM_CLASS]-(aicr)
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitmc1r)<-[R16:HAS_ITEM_CLASS]-(aicrp)
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitmc1r)<-[R17:HAS_ITEM_CLASS]-(aicrpp)
WITH DISTINCT
  g,
  agrp,
  asgrp,
  act,
  ai,
  aitm1,
  aitmc1,
  aicp,
  aicpp,
  v_ai,
  v_aic,
  r1,
  r2,
  r3,
  R1,
  R2,
  R4,
  R5,
  R6,
  R15,
  R16,
  R17,
  apoc.create.vNode(["ActivityItemClass"], properties(aitmc1)) AS v_aitmc1,
  CASE
    WHEN
      R16 IS NOT NULL
      THEN apoc.create.vNode(["ActivityInstanceClass"], properties(aicp))
  END AS v_aicp,
  CASE
    WHEN
      R17 IS NOT NULL
      THEN apoc.create.vNode(["ActivityInstanceClass"], properties(aicpp))
  END AS v_aicpp
WITH DISTINCT
  g,
  agrp,
  asgrp,
  act,
  ai,
  aitm1,
  aitmc1,
  v_ai,
  v_aic,
  v_aicp,
  v_aicpp,
  v_aitmc1,
  r1,
  r2,
  r3,
  R1,
  R2,
  R4,
  R5,
  R6,
  R15,
  R16,
  R17,
  apoc.create.vRelationship(v_ai, "HAS", {type: "logical"}, aitm1) AS r4,
  apoc.create.vRelationship(aitm1, "OF_CLASS", {type: "logical"}, v_aitmc1) AS r5,
  CASE
    WHEN

reports.title: Activity in Tabular Format - $neodash_activity
reports.query:
// Skip entirely if parameter is empty
WITH $neodash_activity AS actName
WHERE actName <> ''

// Anchor on the specific ActivityValue first (uses index)
MATCH (act:ActivityValue {name: actName})

// Core traversal from anchor
MATCH (act)-[:HAS_GROUPING]->(g:ActivityGrouping)
      -[:HAS_SELECTED_SUBGROUP]->(asgrp:ActivitySubGroupValue),
      (g)-[:HAS_SELECTED_GROUP]->(agrp:ActivityGroupValue),
      (g)<-[:HAS_ACTIVITY]-(aigv:ActivityInstanceGroupingValue)
         <-[:LATEST]-(:ActivityInstanceGroupingRoot)
         <-[:HAS_GROUPING_ROOT]-(:ActivityInstanceRoot)
         -[:LATEST]->(ai:ActivityInstanceValue)
         -[:CONTAINS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]->(aitm1:ActivityItem)

MATCH (ai)-[:ACTIVITY_INSTANCE_CLASS]->(aicr:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)
         -[:LATEST]->(aic:ActivityInstanceClassValue)

// Require ActivityItemClass — was MATCH so keep as MATCH
MATCH (aitmc1r:ActivityItemClassRoot)-[:HAS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]->(aitm1),
      (aitmc1r)-[:LATEST]->(aitmc1:ActivityItemClassValue)

// Require DataType — was MATCH so keep as MATCH
MATCH (aitmc1)-[:HAS_DATA_TYPE]->(:CTTermContext)
      -[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->(dtype_r:CTTermRoot)
      -[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->(:CTTermNameRoot)
      -[:LATEST]->(dtype_val)

// Optional parent class traversals
OPTIONAL MATCH (aicr)-[:PARENT_CLASS]->(aicrp:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(aicp:ActivityInstanceClassValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (aicrp)-[:PARENT_CLASS]->(aicrpp:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(aicpp:ActivityInstanceClassValue)

// Optional item class membership checks
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitmc1r)<-[:HAS_ITEM_CLASS]-(aicr)
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitmc1r)<-[:HAS_ITEM_CLASS]-(aicrp)
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitmc1r)<-[:HAS_ITEM_CLASS]-(aicrpp)

// Optional Role
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitmc1)-[:HAS_ROLE]->(:CTTermContext)
               -[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->(role_r:CTTermRoot)
               -[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->(:CTTermNameRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(role_val)

// Optional CT Terms
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitm1)-[:HAS_CT_TERM]->(ct_context:CTTermContext)
               -[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->(ct2cd:CTTermRoot)
               -[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->(:CTTermNameRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(ct2_sponsor),
               (ct2cd)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->(:CTTermAttributesRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(ct2_cdisc),
               (ct2cd)<-[:HAS_TERM_ROOT]-(:CTCodelistTerm)
               <-[:HAS_TERM]-(clr:CTCodelistRoot)
               <-[:HAS_SELECTED_CODELIST]-(ct_context),
               (ct2cd)<-[:CONTAINS_TERM]-(:Library)

// Optional codelist attributes
OPTIONAL MATCH (clr)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->(clatt:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(cl_cdisc:CTCodelistAttributesValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (clr)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->(:CTCodelistNameRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(cl_sponsor)

// Optional unit dimension on context
OPTIONAL MATCH (ct_context)<-[:HAS_CT_DIMENSION]-(pos_units_in_dim:UnitDefinitionValue)

// Optional unit definition
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitm1)-[:HAS_UNIT_DEFINITION]->(:UnitDefinitionRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(unit_term:UnitDefinitionValue)
               -[:HAS_CT_DIMENSION]->(:CTTermContext)
               -[:HAS_SELECTED_CODELIST]->(cl_unit_root:CTCodelistRoot)
               -[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->(:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(cl_unit_cdisc:CTCodelistAttributesValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (cl_unit_root)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->(:CTCodelistNameRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(cl_unit_sponsor)

// Resolve CT term and codelist values once
WITH
  agrp.name                                     AS ActivityGroup,
  asgrp.name                                    AS ActivitySubGroup,
  act.name                                      AS Activity,
  aitmc1.name                                   AS ActivityItemClass,
  role_val.name                                 AS Role,
  dtype_val.name                                AS DataType,
  // Resolve CT2 with priority: pos_units_in_dim > unit_term > merged ct term
  CASE
    WHEN pos_units_in_dim IS NOT NULL THEN pos_units_in_dim.name
    WHEN unit_term        IS NOT NULL THEN unit_term.name
    WHEN ct2cd            IS NOT NULL
      THEN apoc.map.merge(properties(ct2_cdisc), properties(ct2_sponsor)).name
    ELSE null
  END AS term,
  // Resolve codelist with priority: clr > cl_unit_root
  CASE
    WHEN clr         IS NOT NULL
      THEN apoc.map.merge(properties(cl_cdisc), properties(cl_sponsor)).name
    WHEN cl_unit_root IS NOT NULL
      THEN apoc.map.merge(properties(cl_unit_cdisc), properties(cl_unit_sponsor)).preferred_term
    ELSE null
  END AS CodeList

// Aggregate per Activity + ActivityItemClass combination
WITH
  Activity,
  ActivityItemClass,
  Role,
  DataType,
  CodeList,
  collect(DISTINCT ActivityGroup)    AS ActivityGroups,
  collect(DISTINCT ActivitySubGroup) AS ActivitySubGroups,
  collect(DISTINCT term)             AS Terms

RETURN
  ActivityGroups    AS `Activity Group`,
  ActivitySubGroups AS `Activity Subgroup`,
  Activity,
  ActivityItemClass AS `Activity Item Class`,
  Terms,
  CodeList          AS `Code List`,
  Role,
  DataType          AS `Data Type`

reports.query:

      -[:HAS_SELECTED_SUBGROUP]->(asgrp:ActivitySubGroupValue),

  agrp, asgrp, ai, aitm1, aicr, aic

// 6. Optional item class

OPTIONAL MATCH (ct_context_role)-[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->(role_r:CTTermRoot)
OPTIONAL MATCH (role_r)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->(:CTTermNameRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(role_val)

// 10. Second WITH DISTINCT before expensive CT term lookups
WITH DISTINCT
  agrp, asgrp, ai, aitm1, aicr, aic,
  aitmc1r, aitmc1, aicp,
  dtype_val, role_val

// 11. Optional CT Terms
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitm1)-[:HAS_CT_TERM]->(ct_context:CTTermContext)
OPTIONAL MATCH (ct_context)-[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->(ct2cd:CTTermRoot)
OPTIONAL MATCH (ct2cd)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->(:CTTermNameRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(ct2_sponsor)
OPTIONAL MATCH (ct2cd)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->(:CTTermAttributesRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(ct2_cdisc)

// 12. Optional unit dimension on CT context
OPTIONAL MATCH (ct_context)<-[:HAS_CT_DIMENSION]-(pos_units_in_dim:UnitDefinitionValue)

OPTIONAL MATCH (aitm1)-[:HAS_UNIT_DEFINITION]->(unit_def_root:UnitDefinitionRoot)
OPTIONAL MATCH (unit_def_root)-[:LATEST]->(unit_term:UnitDefinitionValue)

// 14. Optional codelist

               <-[:HAS_TERM]-(clr:CTCodelistRoot)
               <-[:HAS_SELECTED_CODELIST]-(ct_context)
OPTIONAL MATCH (clr)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->(:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(cl_cdisc:CTCodelistAttributesValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (clr)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->(:CTCodelistNameRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(cl_sponsor)

// 15. Optional unit codelist
OPTIONAL MATCH (unit_term)-[:HAS_CT_DIMENSION]->(ct_context2)
OPTIONAL MATCH (ct_context2)-[:HAS_SELECTED_CODELIST]->(cl_unit_root:CTCodelistRoot)
OPTIONAL MATCH (cl_unit_root)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]-(:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(cl_unit_cdisc:CTCodelistAttributesValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (cl_unit_root)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->(:CTCodelistNameRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(cl_unit_sponsor)

// 16. Resolve final CT2 and CL values
WITH DISTINCT
  aic.name AS Class,
  agrp.name AS ActivityGroup,
  asgrp.name AS ActivitySubGroup,
  ai.name AS Instance,
  ai.adam_param_code AS ADAM_CODE,
  aitmc1.name AS `Activity Item Class`,
  role_val.name AS Role,
  dtype_val.name AS `Data Type`,
  COALESCE(
    pos_units_in_dim.name,
    unit_term.name,
    ct2_sponsor.name,
    ct2_cdisc.name
  ) AS terms,
  COALESCE(
    cl_sponsor.preferred_term,
    cl_cdisc.name,
    cl_unit_sponsor.preferred_term,
    cl_unit_cdisc.name
  ) AS `Code List`

// 17. Final aggregation
RETURN DISTINCT
  Class,
  Instance,
  ADAM_CODE,
  `Activity Item Class`,
  apoc.convert.toSet(collect(terms)) AS Term,
  `Code List`,
  Role,
  `Data Type`

reports.title: Activity as CDISC SDTM Dataset Specialization - $neodash_cdisc_instance
reports.query:
// ============================================================================
// BC -> SDTM Dataset Specialization  (compliant with cdisc_sdtm_model.yaml)
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Fixes vs. the original saved query:
//   1. Emit packageDate + packageType ('sdtm')            -> required SDTMGroup slots
//   2. originType / originSource: taken from the SponsorModelDatasetVariableInstance
//      (origin_type / origin_source, already valid OriginTypeEnum/OriginSourceEnum)
//      when present; otherwise derived from the SDTM variable role (--ORRES/--ORRESU
//      -> Collected; --STRESC/--STRESN -> Derived; --STRESU/--TEST(CD)/--DECOD ->
//      Assigned; --TEST(CD) -> Sponsor; result/unit -> Vendor).
//   3. codelist.conceptId: sponsor uids (e.g. CTCodelist_000038) coerced to
//      'CNEW' so they satisfy ^(C[0-9]+|CNEW)$; href only for real C-codes
//   4. assignedTerm.conceptId: omitted unless it is a real C-code (pattern
//      ^(C[0-9]+|CNEW)$, and the field is optional)
//   5. SDTM flavour enrichment:
//      * dataType falls back to DatasetVariableInstance.simple_datatype
//        (Char -> text, Num -> float) so it is no longer null.
//      * codelist.conceptId/href use the true NCI C-code from
//        CTCodelistAttributesValue.concept_id (not the sponsor root uid).
//      * mandatoryVariable/mandatoryValue derived from the SDTM variable core
//        (Req -> true/true, Exp -> true/false, Perm -> false/false).
//      * unit variables (*STRESU / *ORRESU): codelist populated from the unit
//        codelist (ct_context_unit -> HAS_SELECTED_CODELIST) and the assigned
//        term value from the unit term (ct_context_unit -> HAS_SELECTED_TERM).
//        --STRESU (standard unit, item class C82587) is reduced to a SINGLE
//        standard unit: the master UnitDefinition (else the first unit).
//   6. Define-XML operational metadata (BC Curation GL rows 94-95):
//      * vlmRole: classifies each variable's semantic role in the BC (result /
//        unit / decode / reference / topic / grouping_* / timing / ...), from the
//        ActivityItemClass role term with an SDTM structural fall-through.
//      * vlmTarget: BC-DRIVEN -> the Activity Instance's vlmRole (result/unit/
//        decode/reference) sets it; the sponsor model's value-level metadata
//        (value_lvl_* columns) is only a fallback.
//      * comparator: WhereClause key cardinality (topic/grouping -> 'EQ' single
//        term, 'IN' value set / subset codelist); non-keys left null.
//
// Performance:
//   * Unused relationship variables removed (only property/aggregated ones kept).
//   * The aitmc1 exclusion filter is applied as early as possible.
//   * Redundant pass-through variables trimmed between WITH stages.
// Parameters: $neodash_cdisc_instance, $neodash_sdtmversion
// ============================================================================

// --- SDTM specialization graph ---------------------------------------------
MATCH
  (act:ActivityValue)-[:HAS_GROUPING]->
  (g:ActivityGrouping)-[:HAS_SELECTED_SUBGROUP]->
  (asgrp:ActivitySubGroupValue),
  (g)-[:HAS_SELECTED_GROUP]->(agrp:ActivityGroupValue)
MATCH
  (g)<-[:HAS_ACTIVITY]-
  (aigv:ActivityInstanceGroupingValue)<-[:LATEST]-
  (aigr:ActivityInstanceGroupingRoot)<-[:HAS_GROUPING_ROOT]-
  (air:ActivityInstanceRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (ai:ActivityInstanceValue)-[:CONTAINS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]->
  (aitm1:ActivityItem)
WHERE ai.adam_param_code = $neodash_cdisc_instance
MATCH
  (ai)-[:ACTIVITY_INSTANCE_CLASS]->
  (aicr:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (aic:ActivityInstanceClassValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aitm1)<-[:HAS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]-
  (aitmc1r:ActivityItemClassRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (aitmc1:ActivityItemClassValue)
// perf: drop excluded item classes as early as possible (keeps null aitmc1 rows out too)
WITH act, g, asgrp, agrp, ai, aitm1, aicr, aic, aitmc1r, aitmc1
WHERE aitmc1 IS NULL OR NOT aitmc1.name IN ['unit_dimension', 'domain']

OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aicr)-[:PARENT_CLASS]->
  (aicrp:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (aicp:ActivityInstanceClassValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aicrp)-[:PARENT_CLASS]->
  (aicrpp:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (aicpp:ActivityInstanceClassValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitmc1r)<-[is_mandatory_data1:HAS_ITEM_CLASS]-(aicr)
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitmc1r)<-[is_mandatory_data2:HAS_ITEM_CLASS]-(aicrp)
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitmc1r)<-[is_mandatory_data3:HAS_ITEM_CLASS]-(aicrpp)

// --- Terms ------------------------------------------------------------------
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aitm1)-[:HAS_CT_TERM]->
  (ct_context:CTTermContext)-[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->
  (ct2cd:CTTermRoot)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->
  (:CTTermNameRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (ct2_sponsor),
  (ct2cd)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (:CTTermAttributesRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (ct2_cdisc),
  (ct2cd)<-[:HAS_TERM_ROOT]-
  (term:CTCodelistTerm)<-[:HAS_TERM]-
  (clr:CTCodelistRoot)<-[:HAS_SELECTED_CODELIST]-
  (ct_context),
  (ct2cd)<-[:CONTAINS_TERM]-(lib:Library)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aitm1)-[:HAS_UNIT_DEFINITION]->
  (unitdefr:UnitDefinitionRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (unitdef:UnitDefinitionValue)-[:HAS_CT_UNIT]->
  (ct_context_unit:CTTermContext)-[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->
  (unit_code:CTTermRoot)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->
  (:CTTermNameRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (unit_sponsor),
  (unit_code)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (:CTTermAttributesRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (unit_cdisc),
  (unitdef)-[:HAS_CT_DIMENSION]->
  (ct_context2)-[:HAS_SELECTED_CODELIST]->
  (cl_unit_root:CTCodelistRoot),
  (cl_unit_root)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]-
  (:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (cl_unit_cdisc:CTCodelistAttributesValue)
// Unit codelist + unit term straight off the unit CTTermContext -----------
// (unit_cl_val = the units codelist; unit_term / unit_submision_value = the
//  selected unit term's CDISC attributes + submission value.)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (ct_context_unit)-[:HAS_SELECTED_CODELIST]->
  (unit_cl:CTCodelistRoot)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (unit_cl_val:CTCodelistAttributesValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (ct_context_unit)-[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->
  (unit_term_root:CTTermRoot)<-[:HAS_TERM_ROOT]-
  (unit_submision_value:CTCodelistTerm),
  (unit_term_root)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (:CTTermAttributesRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (unit_term:CTTermAttributesValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (clr:CTCodelistRoot)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (cl_cdisc:CTCodelistAttributesValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (clr)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->
  (:CTCodelistNameRoot)-[:LATEST]-
  (cl_sponsor)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aitmc1)-[:HAS_ROLE]->
  (ct_context_role)-[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->
  (role_r:CTTermRoot)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->
  (ctnr_role)-[:LATEST]->
  (role_val)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aitmc1)-[:HAS_DATA_TYPE]->
  (ct_context_dtype)-[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->
  (dtype_r),
  (dtype_r)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->(ctnr_dtype)-[:LATEST]->(dtype_val)

// --- Domain (topic) resolution ---------------------------------------------
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (ai)-[:CONTAINS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]->
  (aitm1_dom:ActivityItem)<-[:HAS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]-
  (:ActivityItemClassRoot)-[:MAPS_VARIABLE_CLASS]->
  (dom_class:VariableClass {uid: 'DOMAIN'}),
  (aitm1_dom)-[:HAS_CT_TERM]->
  (:CTTermContext)-[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->
  (:CTTermRoot)<-[:HAS_TERM_ROOT]-
  (ct2_dom:CTCodelistTerm),
  (dom_class)-[:HAS_INSTANCE]->
  (:VariableClassInstance)<-
    [:IMPLEMENTS_VARIABLE {version_number: $neodash_sdtmversion}]-
  (:DatasetVariableInstance)<-
    [:HAS_DATASET_VARIABLE {version_number: $neodash_sdtmversion}]-
  (:DatasetInstance)<-[:HAS_INSTANCE]-
  (ds:Dataset)
WHERE ds.uid = ct2_dom.submission_value

// --- Variable-class -> dataset-variable mapping ----------------------------
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aitmc1r)-[:MAPS_VARIABLE_CLASS]->
  (varcl:VariableClass)-[:HAS_INSTANCE]->
  (varcli:VariableClassInstance),
  (varcli)<-[:IMPLEMENTS_VARIABLE {version_number: $neodash_sdtmversion}]-
  (var:DatasetVariableInstance)<-
    [:HAS_DATASET_VARIABLE {version_number: $neodash_sdtmversion}]-
  (dsi:DatasetInstance)<-[:HAS_INSTANCE]-
  (ds:Dataset)<-[:HAS_DATASET]-
  (dmcat:DataModelCatalogue)-[:CONTAINS_VERSION]->
  (dmig:DataModelVersion),
  (dsi)<-[:HAS_DATASET]-
  (dmigv:DataModelIGValue)<-[:CONTAINS_DATA_MODEL_IG]-
  (dmig),
  (dmcat)-[:HAS_DATASET_VARIABLE]->
  (dsv:DatasetVariable)-[:HAS_INSTANCE]->
  (var)
WHERE dmigv.version_number = $neodash_sdtmversion
// Sponsor-model variable instance for THIS IG version -> carries the sponsor's
// Define-XML origin_type / origin_source and the value-level (VLM) metadata.
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (ds)-[:HAS_INSTANCE]->
  (sponsor_ds:SponsorModelDatasetInstance)-[:HAS_DATASET_VARIABLE]->
  (sdv:SponsorModelDatasetVariableInstance)<-[:HAS_INSTANCE]-
  (dsv:DatasetVariable),
  (sponsor_ds)<-[:HAS_DATASET]-
  (sponsor_model:SponsorModelValue)-[:EXTENDS_VERSION]->(dmigv)

// --- normalise: mandatory flag + trim to needed vars -----------------------
WITH DISTINCT
  asgrp,
  ai,
  aitmc1,
  dmigv,
  ds,
  varcl,
  dsv,
  var,
  dtype_val,
  clr,
  cl_cdisc,
  cl_sponsor,
  ct2cd,
  ct2_cdisc,
  ct2_sponsor,
  unit_code.uid AS unit_code,
  unit_cdisc,
  unit_sponsor,
  unit_cl_val,
  unit_term,
  unit_submision_value,
  // master-unit flag from the UnitDefinition, used to pick the single
  // standard unit for --STRESU (item class C82587).
  unitdef.master_unit AS unit_is_master,
  unitdef.name AS unit_def_name,
  // BC-native role of the item (ActivityItemClass HAS_ROLE term) -> vlmRole
  role_val.name AS item_role,
  // Sponsor Define-XML origin (valid OriginTypeEnum / OriginSourceEnum values)
  // taken straight from the SponsorModelDatasetVariableInstance.
  sdv.origin_type AS sdv_origin_type,
  sdv.origin_source AS sdv_origin_source,
  // has_vlm: the variable actually carries value-level metadata on the sponsor
  // model -> a DATA-DRIVEN vlm_target signal (result/unit variables only).
  (sdv.value_lvl_where_cols IS NOT NULL
    OR sdv.value_lvl_label_col IS NOT NULL
    OR sdv.value_lvl_collect_ct_val IS NOT NULL) AS has_vlm,
  coalesce(
    is_mandatory_data1.mandatory,
    is_mandatory_data2.mandatory,
    is_mandatory_data3.mandatory
  ) AS mandatory_variable

// --- build per-term {code,value,shortName} map -----------------------------
WITH
  asgrp,
  ai,
  aitmc1,
  dmigv,
  ds,
  varcl,
  dsv,
  var,
  dtype_val,
  clr,
  cl_cdisc,
  cl_sponsor,
  unit_cl_val,
  unit_term,
  unit_submision_value,
  mandatory_variable,
  item_role,
  sdv_origin_type,
  sdv_origin_source,
  has_vlm,
  CASE
    WHEN ct2cd IS NOT NULL
      THEN
        CASE
          WHEN var.role = 'Topic'
            THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([
              ['code', ct2cd.uid],
              ['value', coalesce(ct2_cdisc.submission_value, toUpper(ct2_sponsor.name))],
              ['shortName', ct2_cdisc.preferred_term]
            ])
          WHEN varcl.uid = '--TEST'
            THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([
              ['code', ct2cd.uid],
              ['value', coalesce(ct2_cdisc.preferred_term, toUpper(ct2_sponsor.name))]
            ])
          ELSE apoc.map.fromPairs([
            ['code', ct2cd.uid],
            ['value', coalesce(ct2_cdisc.submission_value, toUpper(ct2_sponsor.name))]
          ])
        END
    WHEN unit_code IS NOT NULL
      THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([
        // prefer the unit term's own CDISC C-code + submission value
        ['code', coalesce(unit_term.concept_id, unit_code)],
        ['value', coalesce(
          unit_submision_value.submission_value,
          unit_cdisc.submission_value,
          unit_def_name,
          toUpper(unit_sponsor.name))],
        // master flag lets us keep ONE standard unit for --STRESU downstream
        ['master', coalesce(unit_is_master, false)]
      ])
    ELSE
      CASE
        WHEN varcl.uid = '--CAT' THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([['value', asgrp.name]])
      END
  END AS val_list

// --- collect terms per variable --------------------------------------------
WITH
  ai,
  aitmc1,
  dmigv,
  ds,
  varcl,
  dsv,
  var,
  dtype_val,
  clr,
  cl_cdisc,
  cl_sponsor,
  unit_cl_val,
  mandatory_variable,
  item_role,
  sdv_origin_type,
  sdv_origin_source,
  has_vlm,
  collect(DISTINCT val_list) AS terms,
  {
    DATETIME: 'datetime',
    FLOAT: 'float',
    INTEGER: 'integer',
    CTTERM: 'text',
    TEXT: 'text'
  } AS dtype_map

// --- standard unit (--STRESU / item class C82587): keep ONE unit -----------
// Per BC Curation GL, the standard unit is a single assigned value. Reduce the
// collected unit terms to the master UnitDefinition (fall back to the first).
WITH
  ai,
  aitmc1,
  dmigv,
  ds,
  varcl,
  dsv,
  var,
  dtype_val,
  clr,
  cl_cdisc,
  cl_sponsor,
  unit_cl_val,
  mandatory_variable,
  dtype_map,
  item_role,
  sdv_origin_type,
  sdv_origin_source,
  has_vlm,
  CASE
    WHEN dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'STRESU' AND size(terms) > 1
      THEN [coalesce(
        head([t IN terms WHERE t['master'] = true]),
        head(terms))]
    ELSE terms
  END AS terms

// --- derive role/dtype/source/codelist/assignedTerm/valueList/origin -------
WITH
  ai,
  aitmc1,
  dmigv,
  ds,
  varcl,
  dsv,
  var,
  terms,
  has_vlm,
  // mandatory flags from the SDTM variable core on DatasetVariableInstance:
  //   Req  -> variable present (true) + value populated (true)
  //   Exp  -> variable present (true) + value not required (false)
  //   Perm -> neither required (false)
  // Fall back to the BC item-class mandatory when core is absent.
  CASE
    WHEN var.core = 'Req'  THEN true
    WHEN var.core = 'Exp'  THEN true
    WHEN var.core = 'Perm' THEN false
    ELSE coalesce(mandatory_variable, false)
  END AS mandatory_variable,
  CASE WHEN var.core = 'Req' THEN true ELSE false END AS mandatory_value,
  [x IN ['Identifier', 'Qualifier', 'Timing', 'Topic'] WHERE var.role CONTAINS x][0] AS role,
  // dataType: prefer the BC data-type term; fall back to the SDTM variable's
  // simple_datatype on DatasetVariableInstance (Char -> text, Num -> float) so
  // the required-ish enum slot is populated instead of null.
  coalesce(
    dtype_map[toUpper(dtype_val.name)],
    CASE
      WHEN var.simple_datatype = 'Char' THEN 'text'
      WHEN var.simple_datatype = 'Num'  THEN 'float'
    END
  ) AS dtype,
  CASE
    WHEN var.role = 'Topic' THEN apoc.text.join([ds.uid, dsv.uid], '.')
  END AS source,
  // codelist: CTCodelistAttributesValue.concept_id holds the true NCI C-code
  // even when the codelist root uid is a sponsor id -> use it for a real
  // conceptId + href. Fall back to the root uid, then CNEW, to stay compliant.
  CASE
    WHEN clr IS NOT NULL
      THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([
        ['conceptId',
          CASE
            WHEN cl_cdisc.concept_id =~ '^C[0-9]+$' THEN cl_cdisc.concept_id
            WHEN clr.uid =~ '^C[0-9]+$'             THEN clr.uid
            ELSE 'CNEW'
          END],
        ['href',
          CASE
            WHEN cl_cdisc.concept_id =~ '^C[0-9]+$'
              THEN 'https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov/ncitbrowser/ConceptReport.jsp?dictionary=NCI_Thesaurus&ns=ncit&code=' + cl_cdisc.concept_id
            WHEN clr.uid =~ '^C[0-9]+$'
              THEN 'https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov/ncitbrowser/ConceptReport.jsp?dictionary=NCI_Thesaurus&ns=ncit&code=' + clr.uid
            ELSE null
          END],
        ['submissionValue', coalesce(cl_cdisc.submission_value, toUpper(cl_sponsor.name))]
      ])
    // no CT-term codelist -> use the UNIT codelist (e.g. for *STRESU / *ORRESU)
    WHEN unit_cl_val IS NOT NULL
      THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([
        ['conceptId',
          CASE WHEN unit_cl_val.concept_id =~ '^C[0-9]+$' THEN unit_cl_val.concept_id ELSE 'CNEW' END],
        ['href',
          CASE WHEN unit_cl_val.concept_id =~ '^C[0-9]+$'
            THEN 'https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov/ncitbrowser/ConceptReport.jsp?dictionary=NCI_Thesaurus&ns=ncit&code=' + unit_cl_val.concept_id
            ELSE null END],
        ['submissionValue', unit_cl_val.submission_value]
      ])
  END AS cdlist,
  // FIX 4: only include assignedTerm.conceptId when it is a real C-code
  CASE
    WHEN size(terms) = 1
      THEN
        CASE
          WHEN any(term IN terms WHERE 'code' IN keys(term))
            THEN [
              term IN terms |
              CASE
                WHEN term['code'] =~ '^(C[0-9]+|CNEW)$'
                  THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([['conceptId', term['code']], ['value', term['value']]])
                ELSE apoc.map.fromPairs([['value', term['value']]])
              END
            ]
          ELSE [term IN terms | term['value']]
        END
  END AS assignedTerms,
  CASE WHEN size(terms) > 1 THEN [v IN terms | v['value']] END AS valueList,
  // originType (Define-XML v21, OriginTypeEnum): use the sponsor model's
  // origin_type when present; otherwise derive from the SDTM variable
  //   --ORRES/--ORRESU        -> Collected (observed / instrument-captured)
  //   --STRESC/--STRESN       -> Derived   (standardised via a rule)
  //   --STRESU/--TEST(CD)/--DECOD -> Assigned (look-up / designation)
  //   any other collected item -> Collected when is_data_collected = 'Yes'.
  coalesce(
    sdv_origin_type,
    CASE
      WHEN dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'ORRES'  OR dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'ORRESU' THEN 'Collected'
      WHEN dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'STRESC' OR dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'STRESN' THEN 'Derived'
      WHEN dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'STRESU'                                THEN 'Assigned'
      WHEN dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'TESTCD' OR dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'TEST'
        OR dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'DECOD'                                 THEN 'Assigned'
      WHEN aitmc1.is_data_collected = 'Yes'                          THEN 'Collected'
      ELSE null
    END
  ) AS originType,
  // originSource (Define-XML v21, OriginSourceEnum): use the sponsor model's
  // origin_source when present; otherwise derive
  //   --TEST(CD)              -> Sponsor (sponsor-defined test)
  //   result / unit variables -> Vendor  (produced by lab / instrument)
  coalesce(
    sdv_origin_source,
    CASE
      WHEN dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'TESTCD' OR dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'TEST' THEN 'Sponsor'
      WHEN dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'ORRES'  OR dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'ORRESU'
        OR dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'STRESC' OR dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'STRESN'
        OR dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'STRESU'                             THEN 'Vendor'
      ELSE null
    END
  ) AS originSource,
  CASE
    // ---- vlmRole: the variable's semantic role INSIDE the Biomedical Concept. --
    //   The BC *is* the data definition. Classification priority:
    //     1. BC-native: the ActivityItemClass ROLE term (item_role = role_val.name,
    //        matched via HAS_ROLE on aitmc1). This is the role of the item within
    //        the ActivityInstanceClass/BC -- the correct signal, independent of the
    //        SDTM mapping and of any study-level assigned value. Map your CT role
    //        vocabulary to the vlmRole values below.
    //     2. structural fall-through: SDTM variable-CLASS (varcl.uid) + var.role,
    //        used only when item_role is absent or its term is not yet mapped.
    //   Target values: result | unit | decode | reference (the VLM targets);
    //   key values: topic | grouping_key | grouping_candidate; neither: timing |
    //   record_flag | synonym | descriptive | other.
    // -- 1. ActivityItemClass role term (adjust the tokens to your CT role vocab;
    //       an unmatched item_role simply falls through to the structural rules) --
    WHEN item_role IS NOT NULL AND toLower(item_role) CONTAINS 'result'  THEN 'result'
    WHEN item_role IS NOT NULL AND toLower(item_role) CONTAINS 'unit'    THEN 'unit'
    WHEN item_role IS NOT NULL AND toLower(item_role) CONTAINS 'topic'
      AND (varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'TESTCD' OR varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'PARMCD') THEN 'topic'
    WHEN item_role IS NOT NULL AND toLower(item_role) CONTAINS 'grouping' THEN 'grouping_candidate'
    WHEN item_role IS NOT NULL AND toLower(item_role) CONTAINS 'timing'   THEN 'timing'
    WHEN item_role IS NOT NULL AND toLower(item_role) CONTAINS 'synonym'  THEN 'synonym'
    // -- 2. SDTM structural fall-through --
    WHEN varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'ORRES'  OR varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'STRESC'
      OR varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'STRESN'                                 THEN 'result'   // VLM target
    WHEN varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'ORRESU' OR varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'STRESU' THEN 'unit'     // VLM target
    WHEN varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'DECOD'                                  THEN 'decode'   // VLM target
    WHEN varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'VCDREF' OR varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'VCDVER' THEN 'reference' // VLM target; --VAL is context-dependent -> map its item role (or handle explicitly)
    WHEN var.role CONTAINS 'Synonym'                                  THEN 'synonym'  // --TEST/--PARM/--LLT: decode of a code -> neither
    WHEN var.role CONTAINS 'Timing'                                   THEN 'timing'   // dates / intervals -> neither
    WHEN var.role = 'Topic'
      AND (varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'TESTCD' OR varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'PARMCD') THEN 'topic' // findings topic -> WhereClause key
    WHEN varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'FAST'  OR varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'OCCUR'
      OR varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'STAT'  OR varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'REASND'
      OR varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'PRESP'                                  THEN 'record_flag' // collected per-record flags -> neither
    WHEN varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'LOINC'                                  THEN 'descriptive' // derivable from --TESTCD, not a slice (extend, or annotate the DEC)
    WHEN var.role CONTAINS 'Qualifier'                               THEN 'grouping_candidate'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS vlmRole

// --- VLM target flag + WhereClause comparator ------------------------------
//  Derived from vlmRole, NOT from assigned values. The result/unit/decode DECs
//  are the value-level TARGETS (vlmTarget = true). The topic and the
//  *constrained* grouping DECs are the WhereClause KEYS. EQ vs IN is the
//  cardinality of the constraint the SPECIALISATION carries (a value set/subset
//  -> IN, a single term -> EQ) -- specialisation-level metadata, so it holds
//  even when the concrete assigned value is deferred to study level. A grouping
//  DEC the specialisation does NOT constrain (no terms) is permitted but is not
//  a slice, so it gets no comparator (e.g. EGPOS / EGMETHOD in EG.AVCOND). If a
//  specific item role means "always a WhereClause key", map it to 'grouping_key'
//  in the vlmRole CASE above to force EQ even when the value is deferred.
WITH
  ai, aitmc1, dmigv, ds, varcl, dsv, var, terms,
  role, dtype, source, cdlist, assignedTerms, valueList,
  originType, originSource, mandatory_variable, mandatory_value, vlmRole,
  // vlmTarget: the BC (Activity Instance) drives this via vlmRole; the sponsor
  // model's value-level metadata (has_vlm) is only a fallback when vlmRole does
  // not classify the variable as a VLM target.
  CASE
    WHEN vlmRole IN ['result', 'unit', 'decode', 'reference'] THEN true
    WHEN has_vlm THEN true
    ELSE null
  END AS vlmTarget,
  CASE
    WHEN vlmRole = 'topic' THEN 'EQ'
    WHEN vlmRole IN ['grouping_key', 'grouping_candidate']
      THEN CASE
             WHEN valueList IS NOT NULL                                 THEN 'IN'   // constrained to a value set / subset codelist
             WHEN assignedTerms IS NOT NULL OR vlmRole = 'grouping_key' THEN 'EQ'   // constrained to a single term (or explicitly flagged a key)
             ELSE null                                                              // permitted but NOT constrained -> not a WhereClause key
           END
    ELSE null                                                                       // result / unit / decode / timing / record_flag / synonym / descriptive / other
  END AS comparator

// --- assemble the SDTMVariable map -----------------------------------------
WITH
  ai,
  aitmc1,
  dmigv,
  ds,
  varcl,
  dsv,
  var,
  role,
  dtype,
  assignedTerms,
  valueList,
  cdlist,
  source,
  terms,
  originType,
  originSource,
  CASE
    WHEN assignedTerms IS NOT NULL
      THEN
        CASE
          WHEN var.role = 'Topic' AND dsv.uid = cdlist['submissionValue']
            THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([
              ['name', dsv.uid],
              ['isNonStandard', false],
              ['role', role],
              ['dataType', dtype],
              ['codelist', cdlist],
              ['assignedTerm', assignedTerms[0]],
              ['mandatoryVariable', mandatory_variable],
              ['mandatoryValue', mandatory_value],
              ['originType', originType],
              ['originSource', originSource],
              ['comparator', comparator]   // topic --TESTCD/--PARMCD -> 'EQ' (VLM WhereClause)
            ])
          WHEN varcl.uid = '--TEST' AND dsv.uid = cdlist['submissionValue']
            THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([
              ['name', dsv.uid],
              ['isNonStandard', false],
              ['role', role],
              ['dataType', dtype],
              ['codelist', cdlist],
              ['assignedTerm', assignedTerms[0]],
              ['mandatoryVariable', mandatory_variable],
              ['mandatoryValue', mandatory_value],
              ['originType', originType],
              ['originSource', originSource]
            ])
          WHEN NOT varcl.uid CONTAINS 'TEST'
            THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([
              ['name', dsv.uid],
              ['dataElementConceptId', aitmc1.nci_concept_id],
              ['isNonStandard', false],
              ['role', role],
              ['dataType', dtype],
              ['codelist', cdlist],
              ['assignedTerm', assignedTerms[0]],
              ['mandatoryVariable', mandatory_variable],
              ['mandatoryValue', mandatory_value],
              ['originType', originType],
              ['originSource', originSource],
              ['vlmTarget', vlmTarget],
              ['comparator', comparator]
            ])
        END
    WHEN valueList IS NOT NULL
      THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([
        ['name', dsv.uid],
        ['dataElementConceptId', aitmc1.nci_concept_id],
        ['isNonStandard', false],
        ['codelist', cdlist],
        ['valueList', valueList],
        ['role', role],
        ['originType', originType],
        ['originSource', originSource],
        ['vlmTarget', vlmTarget],
        ['comparator', comparator],
        ['mandatoryVariable', mandatory_variable],
        ['mandatoryValue', mandatory_value]
      ])
    ELSE apoc.map.fromPairs([
      ['name', dsv.uid],
      ['dataElementConceptId', aitmc1.nci_concept_id],
      ['isNonStandard', false],
      ['role', role],
      ['dataType', dtype],
      ['codelist', cdlist],
      ['valueList', valueList],
      ['originType', originType],
      ['originSource', originSource],
      ['vlmTarget', vlmTarget],
      ['comparator', comparator],
      ['mandatoryVariable', mandatory_variable],
      ['mandatoryValue', mandatory_value]
    ])
  END AS dataElement,
  ai.adam_param_code AS datasetSpecializationId,
  CASE WHEN var.role = 'Topic' THEN [v IN terms | v['shortName']][0] END AS shortName,
  // biomedicalConceptId (recommended): the Topic term's C-code, FK to the BC
  CASE
    WHEN var.role = 'Topic'
      THEN [v IN terms WHERE 'code' IN keys(v) | v['code']][0]
  END AS biomedicalConceptId

// --- aggregate variables into a single SDTM group --------------------------
WITH
  ai,
  dmigv,
  ds,
  apoc.coll.toSet(collect(shortName))[0] AS shortName,
  apoc.coll.toSet(collect(source))[0] AS source,
  apoc.coll.toSet(collect(datasetSpecializationId))[0] AS datasetSpecializationId,
  apoc.coll.toSet(collect(biomedicalConceptId))[0] AS biomedicalConceptId,
  collect(DISTINCT dataElement) AS vars

// --- FIX 1: emit packageDate + packageType ---------------------------------
RETURN apoc.map.fromPairs([
  ['packageDate', toString(date())],
  ['packageType', 'sdtm'],
  ['datasetSpecializationId', datasetSpecializationId],
  ['domain', ds.uid],
  ['shortName', shortName],
  ['source', source],
  ['sdtmigStartVersion', dmigv.version_number],
  ['sdtmigEndVersion', ''],
  // recommended FK; only emit a value when it is a valid BC concept id
  ['biomedicalConceptId',
    CASE WHEN biomedicalConceptId =~ '^(C[0-9]+|NEW_[A-Z_]*[0-9]*)$'
      THEN biomedicalConceptId ELSE null END],
  ['variables', vars]
]) AS activity

reports.query:
// ============================================================================
// Activity in CDISC BC format  (compliant with cdisc_bc_model.yaml)
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Key design points:
//  * The activity is a "virtual" view over MANY ActivityInstanceValue (ai).
//    Different ai's may sit in different ActivitySubGroupValue -> we COMBINE
//    subgroups (categories) and result scales into activity-level SETS so the
//    output is a single merged BiomedicalConcept.
//  * The BC conceptId comes from the Topic role term (ct2cd.uid) and is
//    promoted to an activity-level SCALAR *before* any item filtering, so the
//    downstream DEC filters never null it out.
//  * `ai` is NOT carried past the graph match (it is not used downstream).
//  * API round-trips minimised: constant C82590 loaded once; per-concept
//    enrichment collapsed to 2 calls (minimal,definitions,synonyms + parents);
//    single startsWith item search.
// ============================================================================

// --- A1: load the constant NCI inverse-associations payload ONCE ------------
CALL
  apoc.load.json(
    'https://api-evsrest.nci.nih.gov/api/v1/concept/ncit/C82590?include=minimal%2CinverseAssociations'
  )
  YIELD value
WITH value['inverseAssociations'] AS class_concepts

// --- graph match ------------------------------------------------------------
MATCH
  (act:ActivityValue)-[:HAS_GROUPING]->
  (g:ActivityGrouping)-[:HAS_SELECTED_SUBGROUP]->
  (asgrp:ActivitySubGroupValue),
  (g)-[:HAS_SELECTED_GROUP]->(agrp:ActivityGroupValue)
WHERE act.name = $neodash_cdisc_activity
MATCH
  (g)<-[:HAS_ACTIVITY]-
  (aigv:ActivityInstanceGroupingValue)<-[:LATEST]-
  (aigr:ActivityInstanceGroupingRoot)<-[:HAS_GROUPING_ROOT]-
  (air:ActivityInstanceRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (ai:ActivityInstanceValue)-[:CONTAINS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]->
  (aitm1:ActivityItem)
MATCH
  (ai)-[:ACTIVITY_INSTANCE_CLASS]->
  (aicr:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (aic:ActivityInstanceClassValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aitm1)<-[:HAS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]-
  (aitmc1r:ActivityItemClassRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (aitmc1:ActivityItemClassValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aitm1)-[:HAS_CT_TERM]->
  (ct_context:CTTermContext)-[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->
  (ct2cd:CTTermRoot)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->
  (:CTTermNameRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (ct2_sponsor),
  (ct2cd)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (:CTTermAttributesRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (ct2_cdisc),
  (ct2cd)<-[:HAS_TERM_ROOT]-
  (term:CTCodelistTerm)<-[:HAS_TERM]-

        ''
      )
  END AS aitmc1_term
WITH
  ActivityName,
  aiclass,
  asgrp,
  aitmc1,
  val_list,
  var_order,
  dtype,
  conceptId,
  apoc.text.replace(aitmc1_term, " ", "%20") AS aitmc1_term

// --- A3: single startsWith item search (superset of match) ------------------
CALL
  apoc.load.json(
    "https://api-evsrest.nci.nih.gov/api/v1/concept/ncit/search?fromRecord=0&include=minimal" +
    "&pageSize=10&term=" +
    aitmc1_term +
    "&type=startsWith&value=term"
  )
  YIELD value
WITH
  ActivityName,
  aiclass,
  asgrp,
  aitmc1,
  val_list,
  var_order,
  dtype,
  conceptId,
  coalesce(
    aitmc1.nci_concept_id,
    head([v IN value.concepts | v.code])
  ) AS item_concept_id
WITH
  ActivityName,
  aiclass,
  asgrp,
  aitmc1,
  val_list,
  var_order,
  dtype,
  conceptId,
  item_concept_id,
  CASE
    WHEN item_concept_id IS NULL THEN null
    ELSE
      'https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov/ncitbrowser/ConceptReport.jsp?dictionary=NCI_Thesaurus&ns=ncit&code=' +
      item_concept_id
  END AS href

// --- collapse item-rows -> one row per DEC ----------------------------------
WITH DISTINCT
  ActivityName,
  aiclass,
  asgrp,
  conceptId,
  aitmc1.name AS aitmc1Name,
  var_order,
  apoc.text.join(collect(DISTINCT dtype), ',') AS dtypes,
  apoc.coll.toSet(apoc.coll.flatten(collect(DISTINCT val_list))) AS val_list,
  apoc.coll.toSet(collect(DISTINCT href)) AS href,
  apoc.coll.toSet(collect(DISTINCT item_concept_id)) AS item_concept_id
WHERE NOT aitmc1Name IN ['domain', 'test_code', 'test_name', 'unit_dimension']
WITH
  ActivityName,
  aiclass,
  asgrp,
  conceptId,
  aitmc1Name,
  var_order,
  // standard_unit (C82587) is capped to a SINGLE standard unit value.
  CASE
    WHEN aitmc1Name = 'standard_unit'
      THEN [head([v IN val_list WHERE v IS NOT NULL])]
    ELSE [v IN val_list WHERE v IS NOT NULL]
  END AS val_list,
  CASE
    WHEN size(href) = 0 THEN null
    ELSE head(href)
  END AS href,
  CASE
    WHEN size(item_concept_id) = 0 THEN null
    ELSE head(item_concept_id)
  END AS item_concept_id,
  CASE
    WHEN dtypes IS NULL OR dtypes = '' THEN 'string'
    ELSE dtypes
  END AS dtypes

// --- build one DEC map per row (var_order kept only for sorting) ------------
WITH
  ActivityName,
  aiclass,
  asgrp,
  conceptId,
  coalesce(
    item_concept_id,
    'NEW_' + apoc.text.replace(toUpper(aitmc1Name), '[^A-Z_]', '')
  ) AS decConceptId,
  item_concept_id,
  href,
  aitmc1Name,
  dtypes,
  val_list,
  var_order
CALL apoc.do.when(
  item_concept_id =~ '^C[0-9]+$',
  'CALL apoc.load.json("https://api-evsrest.nci.nih.gov/api/v1/concept/ncit/" + code + "?include=minimal") YIELD value RETURN value.name AS preferredName',
  'RETURN null AS preferredName',
  {code: item_concept_id}
) YIELD value AS decName
WITH
  ActivityName,
  aiclass,
  asgrp,
  conceptId,
  apoc.map.fromPairs([
    ['conceptId', decConceptId],
    ['ncitCode',
      CASE WHEN item_concept_id =~ '^C[0-9]+$' THEN item_concept_id ELSE null END],
    ['href', href],
    ['shortName', coalesce(decName.preferredName, aitmc1Name)],
    ['dataType', dtypes],
    ['exampleSet', val_list],
    ['var_order', var_order]
  ]) AS dec

// --- aggregate DEC rows to a single BC --------------------------------------
WITH
  ActivityName,
  aiclass,
  asgrp,
  conceptId,
  [
    m IN apoc.coll.sortMaps(collect(DISTINCT dec), '^var_order')
    | apoc.map.removeKey(m, 'var_order')
  ] AS vars
WITH
  ActivityName,
  aiclass,
  asgrp,
  vars,
  CASE
    WHEN conceptId IS NULL THEN 'C17998'
    ELSE conceptId
  END AS conceptId

// --- A2: minimal + definitions + synonyms in ONE call, on the Topic concept -
CALL
  apoc.load.json(
    "https://api-evsrest.nci.nih.gov/api/v1/concept/ncit/" +
    conceptId +
    "?include=minimal,definitions,synonyms"
  )
  YIELD value
WITH
  ActivityName,
  aiclass,
  asgrp,
  vars,
  conceptId,
  value.name AS conceptName,
  coalesce(
    [d IN value.definitions WHERE d.source = 'NCI'][0]['definition'],
    [d IN value.definitions WHERE d.source = 'CDISC'][0]['definition'],
    [d IN value.definitions WHERE d.source = 'NCI-GLOSS'][0]['definition'],
    [d IN value.definitions WHERE d.source = 'CDISC-GLOSS'][0]['definition'],
    head([d IN value.definitions | d.definition])
  ) AS conceptDefinition,
  apoc.coll.toSet(
    [
      s IN value.synonyms
      WHERE s.name IS NOT NULL
        AND toLower(s.name) <> toLower(value.name)
      | s.name
    ]) AS conceptSynonyms

// --- second (and only other) concept call: parents --------------------------
CALL
  apoc.load.json(
    "https://api-evsrest.nci.nih.gov/api/v1/concept/ncit/" +
    conceptId +
    "/parents"
  )
  YIELD value
WITH
  ActivityName,
  aiclass,
  asgrp,
  vars,
  conceptId,
  conceptName,
  conceptDefinition,
  conceptSynonyms,
  collect(value.code)[0] AS parentConceptId

// --- TABLE output: one row per DataElementConcept ---------------------------
// Columns + order mirror the CDISC export (cdisc_biomedical_concepts_latest.xlsx
// 'Biomedical Concepts' sheet). NCIt-code columns that are hyperlinks in the
// export get a companion '<col>.href' column immediately after (the export cell
// hyperlink cannot be reproduced in a NeoDash table). Multivalue cells use ';'.
WITH
  conceptId,
  parentConceptId,
  asgrp,
  aiclass,
  conceptSynonyms,
  coalesce(conceptName, ActivityName) AS shortName,
  coalesce(conceptDefinition, 'Provisional definition pending NCIt curation.') AS definition,
  vars
UNWIND (CASE WHEN size(vars) = 0 THEN [null] ELSE vars END) AS dec
RETURN
  toString(date()) AS package_date,
  shortName AS short_name,
  conceptId AS bc_id,
  CASE WHEN conceptId =~ '^C[0-9]+$' THEN conceptId ELSE null END AS ncit_code,
  CASE WHEN conceptId =~ '^C[0-9]+$'
    THEN 'https://evsexplore.semantics.cancer.gov/evsexplore/concept/ncit/' + conceptId
    ELSE null END AS `ncit_code.href`,
  parentConceptId AS parent_bc_id,
  CASE WHEN parentConceptId =~ '^C[0-9]+$'
    THEN 'https://evsexplore.semantics.cancer.gov/evsexplore/concept/ncit/' + parentConceptId
    ELSE null END AS `parent_bc_id.href`,
  apoc.text.join(coalesce(asgrp, []), ';') AS bc_categories,
  apoc.text.join(coalesce(conceptSynonyms, []), ';') AS synonyms,
  apoc.text.join(coalesce(aiclass, []), ';') AS result_scales,
  definition AS definition,
  null AS system,
  null AS system_name,
  null AS code,
  dec['conceptId'] AS dec_id,
  dec['ncitCode'] AS ncit_dec_code,
  CASE WHEN dec['ncitCode'] =~ '^C[0-9]+$'
    THEN 'https://evsexplore.semantics.cancer.gov/evsexplore/concept/ncit/' + dec['ncitCode']
    ELSE null END AS `ncit_dec_code.href`,
  dec['shortName'] AS dec_label,
  dec['dataType'] AS data_type,
  CASE WHEN size(dec['exampleSet'])=0 THEN ' ' ELSE apoc.text.join(coalesce(dec['exampleSet'], []), ';') END AS example_set

reports.title: SDTM Specialization tabular view:  $neodash_cdisc_instance
reports.query:
// ============================================================================
// BC -> SDTM Dataset Specialization -- TABLE VIEW
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Same logic as bc_sdtm_specialization.cypher, but returns ONE ROW PER
// SDTMVariable for a NeoDash table. Column NAMES and ORDER mirror the CDISC
// export cdisc_sdtm_dataset_specializations_latest.xlsx ('SDTM Dataset
// Specializations' sheet):
//   package_date, bc_id, [bc_id.href], sdtmig_start_version, sdtmig_end_version,
//   domain, vlm_source, vlm_group_id, short_name, sdtm_variable, dec_id,
//   [dec_id.href], nsv_flag, codelist, [codelist.href],
//   codelist_submission_value, subset_codelist, value_list, assigned_term,
//   assigned_value, role, subject, linking_phrase, predicate_term, object,
//   data_type, length, format, significant_digits, mandatory_variable,
//   mandatory_value, origin_type, origin_source, comparator, vlm_target
// origin_type / origin_source come straight from the SponsorModelDataset-
// VariableInstance (origin_type / origin_source) when present, else derived.
// vlm_target is BC-DRIVEN: the Activity Instance's vlmRole (result/unit/decode/
// reference) sets it; the sponsor model's value-level metadata (value_lvl_*)
// is only a fallback. An extra (non-export)
// value_lvl_where_cols column is appended for review.
// Each NCIt-code column that is a clickable hyperlink in the export gets an
// extra '<col>.href' column right after it. Y/N flag columns follow the export
// text convention; value_list uses ';'. Columns not produced by this query
// (subset_codelist, variable relationships, length/format/significant_digits)
// are null to preserve column position.
// Parameters: $neodash_cdisc_instance, $neodash_sdtmversion
// ============================================================================

// --- SDTM specialization graph ---------------------------------------------
MATCH
  (act:ActivityValue)-[:HAS_GROUPING]->
  (g:ActivityGrouping)-[:HAS_SELECTED_SUBGROUP]->
  (asgrp:ActivitySubGroupValue),
  (g)-[:HAS_SELECTED_GROUP]->(agrp:ActivityGroupValue)
MATCH
  (g)<-[:HAS_ACTIVITY]-
  (aigv:ActivityInstanceGroupingValue)<-[:LATEST]-
  (aigr:ActivityInstanceGroupingRoot)<-[:HAS_GROUPING_ROOT]-
  (air:ActivityInstanceRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (ai:ActivityInstanceValue)-[:CONTAINS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]->
  (aitm1:ActivityItem)
WHERE ai.adam_param_code = $neodash_cdisc_instance
MATCH
  (ai)-[:ACTIVITY_INSTANCE_CLASS]->
  (aicr:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (aic:ActivityInstanceClassValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aitm1)<-[:HAS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]-
  (aitmc1r:ActivityItemClassRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (aitmc1:ActivityItemClassValue)
WITH act, g, asgrp, agrp, ai, aitm1, aicr, aic, aitmc1r, aitmc1
WHERE aitmc1 IS NULL OR NOT aitmc1.name IN ['unit_dimension', 'domain']

OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aicr)-[:PARENT_CLASS]->
  (aicrp:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (aicp:ActivityInstanceClassValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aicrp)-[:PARENT_CLASS]->
  (aicrpp:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (aicpp:ActivityInstanceClassValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitmc1r)<-[is_mandatory_data1:HAS_ITEM_CLASS]-(aicr)
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitmc1r)<-[is_mandatory_data2:HAS_ITEM_CLASS]-(aicrp)
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitmc1r)<-[is_mandatory_data3:HAS_ITEM_CLASS]-(aicrpp)

// --- Terms ------------------------------------------------------------------
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aitm1)-[:HAS_CT_TERM]->
  (ct_context:CTTermContext)-[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->
  (ct2cd:CTTermRoot)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->
  (:CTTermNameRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (ct2_sponsor),
  (ct2cd)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (:CTTermAttributesRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (ct2_cdisc),
  (ct2cd)<-[:HAS_TERM_ROOT]-
  (term:CTCodelistTerm)<-[:HAS_TERM]-
  (clr:CTCodelistRoot)<-[:HAS_SELECTED_CODELIST]-
  (ct_context),
  (ct2cd)<-[:CONTAINS_TERM]-(lib:Library)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aitm1)-[:HAS_UNIT_DEFINITION]->
  (unitdefr:UnitDefinitionRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (unitdef:UnitDefinitionValue)-[:HAS_CT_UNIT]->
  (ct_context_unit:CTTermContext)-[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->
  (unit_code:CTTermRoot)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->
  (:CTTermNameRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (unit_sponsor),
  (unit_code)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (:CTTermAttributesRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (unit_cdisc),
  (unitdef)-[:HAS_CT_DIMENSION]->
  (ct_context2)-[:HAS_SELECTED_CODELIST]->
  (cl_unit_root:CTCodelistRoot),
  (cl_unit_root)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]-
  (:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (cl_unit_cdisc:CTCodelistAttributesValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (ct_context_unit)-[:HAS_SELECTED_CODELIST]->
  (unit_cl:CTCodelistRoot)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (unit_cl_val:CTCodelistAttributesValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (ct_context_unit)-[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->
  (unit_term_root:CTTermRoot)<-[:HAS_TERM_ROOT]-
  (unit_submision_value:CTCodelistTerm),
  (unit_term_root)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (:CTTermAttributesRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (unit_term:CTTermAttributesValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (clr:CTCodelistRoot)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (cl_cdisc:CTCodelistAttributesValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (clr)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->
  (:CTCodelistNameRoot)-[:LATEST]-
  (cl_sponsor)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aitmc1)-[:HAS_ROLE]->
  (ct_context_role)-[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->
  (role_r:CTTermRoot)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->
  (ctnr_role)-[:LATEST]->
  (role_val)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aitmc1)-[:HAS_DATA_TYPE]->
  (ct_context_dtype)-[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->
  (dtype_r),
  (dtype_r)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->(ctnr_dtype)-[:LATEST]->(dtype_val)

// --- Domain (topic) resolution ---------------------------------------------
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (ai)-[:CONTAINS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]->
  (aitm1_dom:ActivityItem)<-[:HAS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]-
  (:ActivityItemClassRoot)-[:MAPS_VARIABLE_CLASS]->
  (dom_class:VariableClass {uid: 'DOMAIN'}),
  (aitm1_dom)-[:HAS_CT_TERM]->
  (:CTTermContext)-[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->
  (:CTTermRoot)<-[:HAS_TERM_ROOT]-
  (ct2_dom:CTCodelistTerm),
  (dom_class)-[:HAS_INSTANCE]->
  (:VariableClassInstance)<-
    [:IMPLEMENTS_VARIABLE {version_number: $neodash_sdtmversion}]-
  (:DatasetVariableInstance)<-
    [:HAS_DATASET_VARIABLE {version_number: $neodash_sdtmversion}]-
  (:DatasetInstance)<-[:HAS_INSTANCE]-
  (ds:Dataset)
WHERE ds.uid = ct2_dom.submission_value

// --- Variable-class -> dataset-variable mapping ----------------------------
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aitmc1r)-[:MAPS_VARIABLE_CLASS]->
  (varcl:VariableClass)-[:HAS_INSTANCE]->
  (varcli:VariableClassInstance),
  (varcli)<-[:IMPLEMENTS_VARIABLE {version_number: $neodash_sdtmversion}]-
  (var:DatasetVariableInstance)<-
    [:HAS_DATASET_VARIABLE {version_number: $neodash_sdtmversion}]-
  (dsi:DatasetInstance)<-[:HAS_INSTANCE]-
  (ds:Dataset)<-[:HAS_DATASET]-
  (dmcat:DataModelCatalogue)-[:CONTAINS_VERSION]->
  (dmig:DataModelVersion),
  (dsi)<-[:HAS_DATASET]-
  (dmigv:DataModelIGValue)<-[:CONTAINS_DATA_MODEL_IG]-
  (dmig),
  (dmcat)-[:HAS_DATASET_VARIABLE]->
  (dsv:DatasetVariable)-[:HAS_INSTANCE]->
  (var)
WHERE dmigv.version_number = $neodash_sdtmversion
// Sponsor-model variable instance for THIS IG version -> carries the sponsor's
// Define-XML origin_type / origin_source and the value-level (VLM) metadata.
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (ds)-[:HAS_INSTANCE]->
  (sponsor_ds:SponsorModelDatasetInstance)-[:HAS_DATASET_VARIABLE]->
  (sdv:SponsorModelDatasetVariableInstance)<-[:HAS_INSTANCE]-
  (dsv:DatasetVariable),
  (sponsor_ds)<-[:HAS_DATASET]-
  (sponsor_model:SponsorModelValue)-[:EXTENDS_VERSION]->(dmigv)

// --- normalise: mandatory flag + trim to needed vars -----------------------
WITH DISTINCT
  asgrp,
  ai,
  aitmc1,
  dmigv,
  ds,
  varcl,
  dsv,
  var,
  dtype_val,
  clr,
  cl_cdisc,
  cl_sponsor,
  ct2cd,
  ct2_cdisc,
  ct2_sponsor,
  unit_code.uid AS unit_code,
  unit_cdisc,
  unit_sponsor,
  unit_cl_val,
  unit_term,
  unit_submision_value,
  unitdef.master_unit AS unit_is_master,
  unitdef.name AS unit_def_name,
  role_val.name AS item_role,
  // Sponsor Define-XML origin (valid OriginTypeEnum / OriginSourceEnum) + VLM
  // metadata straight off the SponsorModelDatasetVariableInstance.
  sdv.origin_type AS sdv_origin_type,
  sdv.origin_source AS sdv_origin_source,
  sdv.value_lvl_where_cols AS vlm_where_cols,
  (sdv.value_lvl_where_cols IS NOT NULL
    OR sdv.value_lvl_label_col IS NOT NULL
    OR sdv.value_lvl_collect_ct_val IS NOT NULL) AS has_vlm,
  coalesce(
    is_mandatory_data1.mandatory,
    is_mandatory_data2.mandatory,
    is_mandatory_data3.mandatory
  ) AS mandatory_variable

// --- build per-term {code,value,shortName} map -----------------------------
WITH
  asgrp,
  ai,
  aitmc1,
  dmigv,
  ds,
  varcl,
  dsv,
  var,
  dtype_val,
  clr,
  cl_cdisc,
  cl_sponsor,
  unit_cl_val,
  unit_term,
  unit_submision_value,
  mandatory_variable,
  item_role,
  sdv_origin_type,
  sdv_origin_source,
  vlm_where_cols,
  has_vlm,
  CASE
    WHEN ct2cd IS NOT NULL
      THEN
        CASE
          WHEN var.role = 'Topic'
            THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([
              ['code', ct2cd.uid],
              ['value', coalesce(ct2_cdisc.submission_value, toUpper(ct2_sponsor.name))],
              ['shortName', ct2_cdisc.preferred_term]
            ])
          WHEN varcl.uid = '--TEST'
            THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([
              ['code', ct2cd.uid],
              ['value', coalesce(ct2_cdisc.preferred_term, toUpper(ct2_sponsor.name))]
            ])
          ELSE apoc.map.fromPairs([
            ['code', ct2cd.uid],
            ['value', coalesce(ct2_cdisc.submission_value, toUpper(ct2_sponsor.name))]
          ])
        END
    WHEN unit_code IS NOT NULL
      THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([
        ['code', coalesce(unit_term.concept_id, unit_code)],
        ['value', coalesce(
          unit_submision_value.submission_value,
          unit_cdisc.submission_value,
          unit_def_name,
          toUpper(unit_sponsor.name))],
        ['master', coalesce(unit_is_master, false)]
      ])
    ELSE
      CASE
        WHEN varcl.uid = '--CAT' THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([['value', asgrp.name]])
      END
  END AS val_list

// --- collect terms per variable --------------------------------------------
WITH
  ai,
  aitmc1,
  dmigv,
  ds,
  varcl,
  dsv,
  var,
  dtype_val,
  clr,
  cl_cdisc,
  cl_sponsor,
  unit_cl_val,
  mandatory_variable,
  item_role,
  sdv_origin_type,
  sdv_origin_source,
  vlm_where_cols,
  has_vlm,
  collect(DISTINCT val_list) AS terms,
  {
    DATETIME: 'datetime',
    FLOAT: 'float',
    INTEGER: 'integer',
    CTTERM: 'text',
    TEXT: 'text'
  } AS dtype_map

// --- standard unit (--STRESU / item class C82587): keep ONE unit -----------
WITH
  ai,
  aitmc1,
  dmigv,
  ds,
  varcl,
  dsv,
  var,
  dtype_val,
  clr,
  cl_cdisc,
  cl_sponsor,
  unit_cl_val,
  mandatory_variable,
  dtype_map,
  item_role,
  sdv_origin_type,
  sdv_origin_source,
  vlm_where_cols,
  has_vlm,
  CASE
    WHEN dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'STRESU' AND size(terms) > 1
      THEN [coalesce(
        head([t IN terms WHERE t['master'] = true]),
        head(terms))]
    ELSE terms
  END AS terms

// --- derive role/dtype/source/codelist/assignedTerm/valueList/origin -------
WITH
  ai,
  aitmc1,
  dmigv,
  ds,
  varcl,
  dsv,
  var,
  terms,
  has_vlm,
  vlm_where_cols,
  CASE
    WHEN var.core = 'Req'  THEN true
    WHEN var.core = 'Exp'  THEN true
    WHEN var.core = 'Perm' THEN false
    ELSE coalesce(mandatory_variable, false)
  END AS mandatory_variable,
  CASE WHEN var.core = 'Req' THEN true ELSE false END AS mandatory_value,
  [x IN ['Identifier', 'Qualifier', 'Timing', 'Topic'] WHERE var.role CONTAINS x][0] AS role,
  coalesce(
    dtype_map[toUpper(dtype_val.name)],
    CASE
      WHEN var.simple_datatype = 'Char' THEN 'text'
      WHEN var.simple_datatype = 'Num'  THEN 'float'
    END
  ) AS dtype,
  CASE
    WHEN var.role = 'Topic' THEN apoc.text.join([ds.uid, dsv.uid], '.')
  END AS source,
  CASE
    WHEN clr IS NOT NULL
      THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([
        ['conceptId',
          CASE
            WHEN cl_cdisc.concept_id =~ '^C[0-9]+$' THEN cl_cdisc.concept_id
            WHEN clr.uid =~ '^C[0-9]+$'             THEN clr.uid
            ELSE 'CNEW'
          END],
        ['href',
          CASE
            WHEN cl_cdisc.concept_id =~ '^C[0-9]+$'
              THEN 'https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov/ncitbrowser/ConceptReport.jsp?dictionary=NCI_Thesaurus&ns=ncit&code=' + cl_cdisc.concept_id
            WHEN clr.uid =~ '^C[0-9]+$'
              THEN 'https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov/ncitbrowser/ConceptReport.jsp?dictionary=NCI_Thesaurus&ns=ncit&code=' + clr.uid
            ELSE null
          END],
        ['submissionValue', coalesce(cl_cdisc.submission_value, toUpper(cl_sponsor.name))]
      ])
    WHEN unit_cl_val IS NOT NULL
      THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([
        ['conceptId',
          CASE WHEN unit_cl_val.concept_id =~ '^C[0-9]+$' THEN unit_cl_val.concept_id ELSE 'CNEW' END],
        ['href',
          CASE WHEN unit_cl_val.concept_id =~ '^C[0-9]+$'
            THEN 'https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov/ncitbrowser/ConceptReport.jsp?dictionary=NCI_Thesaurus&ns=ncit&code=' + unit_cl_val.concept_id
            ELSE null END],
        ['submissionValue', unit_cl_val.submission_value]
      ])
  END AS cdlist,
  CASE
    WHEN size(terms) = 1
      THEN
        CASE
          WHEN any(term IN terms WHERE 'code' IN keys(term))
            THEN [
              term IN terms |
              CASE
                WHEN term['code'] =~ '^(C[0-9]+|CNEW)$'
                  THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([['conceptId', term['code']], ['value', term['value']]])
                ELSE apoc.map.fromPairs([['value', term['value']]])
              END
            ]
          ELSE [term IN terms | term['value']]
        END
  END AS assignedTerms,
  CASE WHEN size(terms) > 1 THEN [v IN terms | v['value']] END AS valueList,
  coalesce(
    sdv_origin_type,
    CASE
      WHEN dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'ORRES'  OR dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'ORRESU' THEN 'Collected'
      WHEN dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'STRESC' OR dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'STRESN' THEN 'Derived'
      WHEN dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'STRESU'                                THEN 'Assigned'
      WHEN dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'TESTCD' OR dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'TEST'
        OR dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'DECOD'                                 THEN 'Assigned'
      WHEN aitmc1.is_data_collected = 'Yes'                          THEN 'Collected'
      ELSE null
    END
  ) AS originType,
  coalesce(
    sdv_origin_source,
    CASE
      WHEN dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'TESTCD' OR dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'TEST' THEN 'Sponsor'
      WHEN dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'ORRES'  OR dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'ORRESU'
        OR dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'STRESC' OR dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'STRESN'
        OR dsv.uid ENDS WITH 'STRESU'                             THEN 'Vendor'
      ELSE null
    END
  ) AS originSource,
  CASE
    // ---- vlmRole: the variable's semantic role INSIDE the Biomedical Concept. --
    //   The BC *is* the data definition. Classification priority:
    //     1. BC-native: the ActivityItemClass ROLE term (item_role = role_val.name,
    //        matched via HAS_ROLE on aitmc1). This is the role of the item within
    //        the ActivityInstanceClass/BC -- the correct signal, independent of the
    //        SDTM mapping and of any study-level assigned value. Map your CT role
    //        vocabulary to the vlmRole values below.
    //     2. structural fall-through: SDTM variable-CLASS (varcl.uid) + var.role,
    //        used only when item_role is absent or its term is not yet mapped.
    //   Target values: result | unit | decode | reference (the VLM targets);
    //   key values: topic | grouping_key | grouping_candidate; neither: timing |
    //   record_flag | synonym | descriptive | other.
    // -- 1. ActivityItemClass role term (adjust the tokens to your CT role vocab;
    //       an unmatched item_role simply falls through to the structural rules) --
    WHEN item_role IS NOT NULL AND toLower(item_role) CONTAINS 'result'  THEN 'result'
    WHEN item_role IS NOT NULL AND toLower(item_role) CONTAINS 'unit'    THEN 'unit'
    WHEN item_role IS NOT NULL AND toLower(item_role) CONTAINS 'topic'
      AND (varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'TESTCD' OR varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'PARMCD') THEN 'topic'
    WHEN item_role IS NOT NULL AND toLower(item_role) CONTAINS 'grouping' THEN 'grouping_candidate'
    WHEN item_role IS NOT NULL AND toLower(item_role) CONTAINS 'timing'   THEN 'timing'
    WHEN item_role IS NOT NULL AND toLower(item_role) CONTAINS 'synonym'  THEN 'synonym'
    // -- 2. SDTM structural fall-through --
    WHEN varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'ORRES'  OR varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'STRESC'
      OR varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'STRESN'                                 THEN 'result'   // VLM target
    WHEN varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'ORRESU' OR varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'STRESU' THEN 'unit'     // VLM target
    WHEN varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'DECOD'                                  THEN 'decode'   // VLM target
    WHEN varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'VCDREF' OR varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'VCDVER' THEN 'reference' // VLM target; --VAL is context-dependent -> map its item role (or handle explicitly)
    WHEN var.role CONTAINS 'Synonym'                                  THEN 'synonym'  // --TEST/--PARM/--LLT: decode of a code -> neither
    WHEN var.role CONTAINS 'Timing'                                   THEN 'timing'   // dates / intervals -> neither
    WHEN var.role = 'Topic'
      AND (varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'TESTCD' OR varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'PARMCD') THEN 'topic' // findings topic -> WhereClause key
    WHEN varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'FAST'  OR varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'OCCUR'
      OR varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'STAT'  OR varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'REASND'
      OR varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'PRESP'                                  THEN 'record_flag' // collected per-record flags -> neither
    WHEN varcl.uid ENDS WITH 'LOINC'                                  THEN 'descriptive' // derivable from --TESTCD, not a slice (extend, or annotate the DEC)
    WHEN var.role CONTAINS 'Qualifier'                               THEN 'grouping_candidate'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS vlmRole

// --- VLM target flag + WhereClause comparator ------------------------------
//  Derived from vlmRole, NOT from assigned values. The result/unit/decode DECs
//  are the value-level TARGETS (vlm_target = Y). The topic and the *constrained*
//  grouping DECs are the WhereClause KEYS. EQ vs IN is the cardinality of the
//  constraint the SPECIALISATION carries (a value set/subset -> IN, a single
//  term -> EQ) -- specialisation-level metadata, so it holds even when the
//  concrete assigned value is deferred to study level. A grouping DEC the
//  specialisation does NOT constrain (no terms) is permitted but is not a slice,
//  so it gets no comparator (e.g. EGPOS / EGMETHOD in EG.AVCOND). If a specific
//  item role means "always a WhereClause key", map it to 'grouping_key' in the
//  vlmRole CASE above to force EQ even when the value is deferred to study level.
WITH
  ai, aitmc1, dmigv, ds, varcl, dsv, var, terms,
  role, dtype, source, cdlist, assignedTerms, valueList,
  originType, originSource, mandatory_variable, mandatory_value, vlmRole,
  vlm_where_cols,
  // vlmTarget: the BC (Activity Instance) drives this via vlmRole; the sponsor
  // model's value-level metadata (has_vlm) is only a fallback when vlmRole does
  // not classify the variable as a VLM target.
  CASE
    WHEN vlmRole IN ['result', 'unit', 'decode', 'reference'] THEN true
    WHEN has_vlm THEN true
    ELSE null
  END AS vlmTarget,
  CASE
    WHEN vlmRole = 'topic' THEN 'EQ'
    WHEN vlmRole IN ['grouping_key', 'grouping_candidate']
      THEN CASE
             WHEN valueList IS NOT NULL                                 THEN 'IN'   // constrained to a value set / subset codelist
             WHEN assignedTerms IS NOT NULL OR vlmRole = 'grouping_key' THEN 'EQ'   // constrained to a single term (or explicitly flagged a key)
             ELSE null                                                              // permitted but NOT constrained -> not a WhereClause key
           END
    ELSE null                                                                       // result / unit / decode / timing / record_flag / synonym / descriptive / other
  END AS comparator

// --- assemble the SDTMVariable map -----------------------------------------
WITH
  ai,
  aitmc1,
  dmigv,
  ds,
  varcl,
  dsv,
  var,
  role,
  dtype,
  assignedTerms,
  valueList,
  cdlist,
  source,
  terms,
  originType,
  originSource,
  vlm_where_cols,
  CASE
    WHEN assignedTerms IS NOT NULL
      THEN
        CASE
          WHEN var.role = 'Topic' AND dsv.uid = cdlist['submissionValue']
            THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([
              ['name', dsv.uid],
              ['isNonStandard', false],
              ['role', role],
              ['dataType', dtype],
              ['codelist', cdlist],
              ['assignedTerm', assignedTerms[0]],
              ['mandatoryVariable', mandatory_variable],
              ['mandatoryValue', mandatory_value],
              ['originType', originType],
              ['originSource', originSource],
              ['vlmWhereCols', vlm_where_cols],
              ['comparator', comparator]   // topic --TESTCD/--PARMCD -> 'EQ' (VLM WhereClause)
            ])
          WHEN varcl.uid = '--TEST' AND dsv.uid = cdlist['submissionValue']
            THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([
              ['name', dsv.uid],
              ['isNonStandard', false],
              ['role', role],
              ['dataType', dtype],
              ['codelist', cdlist],
              ['assignedTerm', assignedTerms[0]],
              ['mandatoryVariable', mandatory_variable],
              ['mandatoryValue', mandatory_value],
              ['originType', originType],
              ['originSource', originSource],
              ['vlmWhereCols', vlm_where_cols]
            ])
          WHEN NOT varcl.uid CONTAINS 'TEST'
            THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([
              ['name', dsv.uid],
              ['dataElementConceptId', aitmc1.nci_concept_id],
              ['isNonStandard', false],
              ['role', role],
              ['dataType', dtype],
              ['codelist', cdlist],
              ['assignedTerm', assignedTerms[0]],
              ['mandatoryVariable', mandatory_variable],
              ['mandatoryValue', mandatory_value],
              ['originType', originType],
              ['originSource', originSource],
              ['vlmTarget', vlmTarget],
              ['vlmWhereCols', vlm_where_cols],
              ['comparator', comparator]
            ])
        END
    WHEN valueList IS NOT NULL
      THEN apoc.map.fromPairs([
        ['name', dsv.uid],
        ['dataElementConceptId', aitmc1.nci_concept_id],
        ['isNonStandard', false],
        ['codelist', cdlist],
        ['valueList', valueList],
        ['role', role],
        ['originType', originType],
        ['originSource', originSource],
        ['vlmTarget', vlmTarget],
        ['vlmWhereCols', vlm_where_cols],
        ['comparator', comparator],
        ['mandatoryVariable', mandatory_variable],
        ['mandatoryValue', mandatory_value]
      ])
    ELSE apoc.map.fromPairs([
      ['name', dsv.uid],
      ['dataElementConceptId', aitmc1.nci_concept_id],
      ['isNonStandard', false],
      ['role', role],
      ['dataType', dtype],
      ['codelist', cdlist],
      ['valueList', valueList],
      ['originType', originType],
      ['originSource', originSource],
      ['vlmTarget', vlmTarget],
      ['vlmWhereCols', vlm_where_cols],
      ['comparator', comparator],
      ['mandatoryVariable', mandatory_variable],
      ['mandatoryValue', mandatory_value]
    ])
  END AS dataElement,
  ai.adam_param_code AS datasetSpecializationId,
  CASE WHEN var.role = 'Topic' THEN [v IN terms | v['shortName']][0] END AS shortName,
  CASE
    WHEN var.role = 'Topic'
      THEN [v IN terms WHERE 'code' IN keys(v) | v['code']][0]
  END AS biomedicalConceptId

// --- aggregate group scalars, then emit ONE ROW PER VARIABLE (TABLE) --------
// Columns + order mirror the CDISC export
// (cdisc_sdtm_dataset_specializations_latest.xlsx 'SDTM Dataset Specializations'
// sheet). NCIt-code columns that are hyperlinks in the export get a companion
// '<col>.href' column immediately after. Y/N flag columns follow the export's
// text convention; multivalue value_list uses ';'. Columns not produced by this
// query (subset_codelist, variable relationships, length/format/sig-digits) are
// returned as null to preserve column position.
WITH
  ai,
  dmigv,
  ds,
  apoc.coll.toSet(collect(shortName))[0] AS shortName,
  apoc.coll.toSet(collect(source))[0] AS source,
  apoc.coll.toSet(collect(datasetSpecializationId))[0] AS datasetSpecializationId,
  apoc.coll.toSet(collect(biomedicalConceptId))[0] AS biomedicalConceptId,
  [x IN collect(DISTINCT dataElement) WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS vars
UNWIND vars AS v
RETURN
  toString(date()) AS package_date,
  CASE WHEN biomedicalConceptId =~ '^(C[0-9]+|NEW_[A-Z_]*[0-9]*)$'
    THEN biomedicalConceptId ELSE null END AS bc_id,
  CASE WHEN biomedicalConceptId =~ '^C[0-9]+$'
    THEN 'https://evsexplore.semantics.cancer.gov/evsexplore/concept/ncit/' + biomedicalConceptId
    ELSE null END AS `bc_id.href`,
  dmigv.version_number AS sdtmig_start_version,
  '' AS sdtmig_end_version,
  ds.uid AS domain,
  source AS vlm_source,
  datasetSpecializationId AS vlm_group_id,
  shortName AS short_name,
  v['name'] AS sdtm_variable,
  v['dataElementConceptId'] AS dec_id,
  CASE WHEN v['dataElementConceptId'] =~ '^C[0-9]+$'
    THEN 'https://evsexplore.semantics.cancer.gov/evsexplore/concept/ncit/' + v['dataElementConceptId']
    ELSE null END AS `dec_id.href`,
  CASE WHEN v['isNonStandard'] = true THEN 'Y' WHEN v['isNonStandard'] = false THEN 'N' ELSE null END AS nsv_flag,
  v['codelist']['conceptId'] AS codelist,
  CASE WHEN v['codelist']['conceptId'] =~ '^C[0-9]+$'
    THEN 'https://evsexplore.semantics.cancer.gov/evsexplore/concept/ncit/' + v['codelist']['conceptId']
    ELSE null END AS `codelist.href`,
  v['codelist']['submissionValue'] AS codelist_submission_value,
  null AS subset_codelist,
  apoc.text.join(coalesce(v['valueList'], []), ';') AS value_list,
  CASE WHEN apoc.meta.cypher.type(v['assignedTerm']) = 'MAP'
    THEN v['assignedTerm']['conceptId'] END AS assigned_term,
  CASE WHEN apoc.meta.cypher.type(v['assignedTerm']) = 'MAP'
    THEN v['assignedTerm']['value'] ELSE v['assignedTerm'] END AS assigned_value,
  v['role'] AS role,
  //null AS subject,
  //null AS linking_phrase,
  //null AS predicate_term,
  //null AS object,
  v['dataType'] AS data_type,
  //null AS length,
  //null AS format,
  //null AS significant_digits,
  CASE WHEN v['mandatoryVariable'] = true THEN 'Y' WHEN v['mandatoryVariable'] = false THEN 'N' ELSE null END AS mandatory_variable,
  CASE WHEN v['mandatoryValue'] = true THEN 'Y' WHEN v['mandatoryValue'] = false THEN 'N' ELSE null END AS mandatory_value,
  v['originType'] AS origin_type,
  v['originSource'] AS origin_source,
  v['comparator'] AS comparator,
  CASE WHEN v['vlmTarget'] = true THEN 'Y' ELSE null END AS vlm_target,
  v['vlmWhereCols'] AS value_lvl_where_cols
ORDER BY sdtm_variable

  (aitmc1)-[R45:HAS_DATA_TYPE]->

WITH
  agrp.name AS `Activity Group`,
  asgrp.name AS `Activity Subgroup`,
  act.name AS Activity,
  ai.adam_param_code AS `Activity Instance`,
  aitmc1.name AS `Activity Item Class`,
  CASE
    WHEN aitmc1.name = "unit_dimension" THEN pos_units_in_dim.name
    ELSE
      CASE
        WHEN
          ct2cd IS NOT NULL
          THEN coalesce(ct2_cdisc.preferred_term, ct2_sponsor.name)
        ELSE
          CASE
            WHEN
              unitdefr IS NOT NULL
              THEN coalesce(unit_cdisc.preferred_term, unit_sponsor.name)
          END
      END
  END AS terms,
  CASE
    WHEN clr IS NOT NULL THEN coalesce(cl_cdisc.preferred_term, cl_sponsor.name)
    ELSE
      CASE
        WHEN
          cl_unit_root IS NOT NULL
          THEN coalesce(cl_unit_cdisc.preferred_term, cl_unit_sponsor.name)
      END
  END AS `Code List`,
  role_val.name AS Role,
  dtype_val.name AS `Data Type`
RETURN
  `Activity Instance`,
  `Activity Item Class`,
  apoc.text.join(collect(DISTINCT terms), ",") AS Term,
  `Code List`,
  Role,
  `Data Type`,
  Activity,
  `Activity Subgroup`,
  `Activity Group`
